about: Data: whether everything needed to work out the power is filed, for each pair of a group and a limit from the Limit step. A filing goes on if at least one pair is complete. Otherwise it leaves as 'cannot calculate' (guidebook MD-9), which is not the same as clear: a person should look.

needs.no_orbit: Where the satellite is: its longitude if it stays fixed in the sky (geo.long_nom), or the lowest perigee of its orbits if it moves (orbit.perig_km, zero or more).
needs.no_gain: The gain of the antenna the group transmits through (s_beam.gain for the group's beam, transmitting).
needs.no_power: A power: the peak power (emiss.pep_max) or the power density (emiss.pwr_ds_max). A limit on total power (no reference bandwidth) needs the peak power.
needs.needs_xy: A limit the filing's numbers can be put into: at least one part of the limit's mask that does not depend on extra values the ITU computes elsewhere (the NGSO tables' C4 and C5).

outcomes.complete: Everything needed to work out its power is filed.
outcomes.no_orbit: Its position or orbit is not filed in full, so the distance to Finland cannot be worked out.
outcomes.no_gain: The gain of its transmitting antenna is not filed.
outcomes.no_power: No power is filed for what it transmits.
outcomes.needs_xy: Its only limits need values that are not in the filing.

notes: Each pair gets the first missing item in the order above. A filing that leaves gets the first reason, in that order, that any of its pairs had.
